one_line_answer.text: Check that learners have understood you, so their understanding is the same as yours.

cites.quote: It is important to check that the learners have understood what you have communicated to them. This means ensuring that their understanding is the same as yours.

keywords.bn: নিজের ভাষায় সহজ করে আবার বলা

bangla_explanation: পরিকল্পনা ঠিক আছে কিনা দেখতে দুইটা উপায়: research আর communicate।
প্রথম দিনে observe করুন, ছোট task বা quiz দিন, তবে ভয় না দেখিয়ে।
Learners বুঝেছে কিনা জানতে প্রশ্ন করুন, আর তাদের দিয়ে paraphrasing করান।
লক্ষ্য হলো mutual understanding: আপনি যা বোঝালেন, তারাও তাই বুঝেছে।

example.en: The trainer explains machine safety. Then a learner restates the rules in his own words.
example.bn: মেশিন safety বোঝানোর পরে একজন learner-কে নিজের ভাষায় বলতে বলা হয়।

short.prompt: How do you determine learners' understanding?
short.modelAnswer:
By asking questions I will determine learners' understanding.
I will also:
1. Ask learners to paraphrase the message in their own words.
2. Seek and give feedback.
3. Confirm understanding on outcomes, sequence, support, feedback and assessment.

keyPoints.text: By asking questions I will determine learners understanding.

cites.quote: By asking questions I will determine learners understanding.

keyPoints.text: Paraphrasing is an excellent way of checking understanding.

cites.quote: The technique of paraphrasing (that is, restating the essential parts of the message simply using your own words) is an excellent way of checking understanding.

keyPoints.text: Aim for mutual understanding. Seeking and giving feedback aids this process.

cites.quote: Your aim is to ensure mutual understanding. Seeking and giving feedback aids this process.
